DeMar DeRozan scored the Kings' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 18 times in 77 starts, or 23% of the games they started. Maxime Raynaud was next with 13. The Kings made the game's first field goal in 49% of their 82 games and won 52% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
